description: Host audit for constitution invariant 10 (uniform execution). Files on the model path may bind tensors, run programs, and move bytes, but must not process input text. 'pending' lists host code that still makes content-dependent decisions and must move into compiled circuits before the uniform-engine milestone can be complete.

pending.reason: the bounded-language parser matches token templates in Rust; it must become a recurrent parser circuit; it also converts numerals to integers, which the host formats back to decimal bytes for the number-encode circuit

one-step probes, symbol cleanup, and pronoun resolution now run in the relation-probe and symbol-cleanup circuits, and new slot rows are the probe circuit's bundled query; what remains is write bookkeeping (adding a new symbol to the codebook, slot allocation and metadata) and the mapping from parsed structures to role-filler parts

write-time bookkeeping (slot choice, status, supersession, the key word-count limit) is host code (an update rule); value encoding, the stored-value comparison, and W_FAST writes and recalls run in circuits, but the branches on their outputs and the slot bookkeeping are Rust
